title: 第一卷 第15章 第一次斗法火球符显威第一卷 第16章 寒千山
slug: 凡人修仙从百岁老人娶妻开始
lines: 月黑风高，林府外。
寒家十数武者亦步亦趋的跟在青年身后，直到此地。
“那老头就在里面？”陈仙师低头看向寒千山。
“是，我们买通了林府下人，林寻确实每天都在府中静修。”
“好，就让本大爷看看，这老头是何修为！”陈邪也不墨迹，抬手挥出一道血影，直冲入林府。
片刻之后，血影返回。
陈邪略一打量，满是不屑，“我当什么东西？不过区区炼气一层，就把你们吓成了这样？
走，随我去宰了他！根本不值得取出怨灵幡！”
“可仙师，我等这般大张旗鼓，会不会被人发现？到时候......”寒千山有些顾虑地发问。
“呵！看到的全杀了就是！”陈邪舔了舔嘴唇，桀桀桀的怪笑着。
可很快，他就轻咦一声，“嗯？这老头似乎有所警觉，已经跑了，哈哈哈！有点意思！追！”
他一马当先冲了出去，后面的寒家武者闻声而动。
片刻之前，林府。
正在沉睡的林寻猛然惊醒，将压在身上的玉体移开，坐直身体。
“怎么了夫君？要继续？”杨芸揉着惺忪的眼睛，抬起修长大腿。
林寻拍了拍杨芸的玉臂，一脸严肃，“快起，有人寻仇来了！”
杨芸一脸茫然，“什么？”
“无暇解释，待我离开后你就返回杨家等待，若我数日未归，赶紧跑！有多远跑多远！”
林寻顾不得其他，拿上符箓就向外逃去。
他打量着手臂上若有若无的印记，神情肃穆。
若是一般散修，可能连发现都发现不了，但他不同，对灵气异常敏感，印记上身就有了感应！
这上面的丝丝黑气，分明是魔道的追踪手段。
林寻虽然不解，但行动迅速。
只有逃跑，大家才有一线生机。
可为何有魔道？
要知道，整个越国皆是正道地盘。
魔道弟子，非常少见。
哪来的魔道？
有什么仇怨？
居然要种下印记追踪，这是要不死不休？
至于打一架？
林寻没想过，能逃掉是最好的。
他施展疾步术，向外狂奔。
可只是片刻，身后就传来陈邪的戏谑声，“老头，你倒是机灵，可今日必死无疑！”
话音未落，陈邪手中魔气翻滚，半尺长的血刃浮现，向林寻甩去。
不好！
林寻心头狂跳，只感觉如芒刺在背，反手就打出两张符箓！
霎时间，两道灵气光罩浮现。
护盾符！
血刃顷刻而至！
第一层护罩应声而碎，第二层护罩晃动一下，暂未损伤。
“符箓？”陈邪咧嘴笑了笑，“倒是有些保命手段，呵，区区炼气一层的老头，能买的起几张符箓？”
content_en:
The moon is dark and the wind is high, outside Lin Mansion.
Dozens of warriors from the Han family followed the young man step by step until they reached this point.
"Then the old man is inside?" Chen Xianshi lowered his head and looked at Han Qianshan.
"Yes, we bribed the servants of the Lin Mansion. Lin Xun does meditate in the manor every day."
"Okay, let me see what kind of cultivation this old man has!" Chen Xie raised his hand and waved a blood shadow, rushing straight into the Lin Mansion.
After a while, the blood shadow returned.
Chen Xie looked at it briefly and said with disdain, "Who do I think I am? I'm just one level of Qi refining, but I scared you into this?"
Come on, let me kill him! It’s not worth taking out the Wraith Flag! "
"But Master Immortal, will we be discovered by others if we are so grand? Then..." Han Qianshan asked with some concern.
"Ha! Kill everyone you see!" Chen Xie licked his lips and smiled strangely.
But soon, he exclaimed, "Huh? This old man seems to be alert and has already run away, hahaha! It's interesting! Chase him!"
He rushed out immediately, and the Han family warriors behind him heard the sound and moved.
...
A moment ago, Lin Mansion.
Lin Xun, who was sleeping, suddenly woke up, removed the jade body that was pressing on him, and sat up straight.
"What's wrong, husband? Do you want to continue?" Yang Yun rubbed her groggy eyes and raised her slender thighs.
Lin Xun patted Yang Yun's jade arm with a serious look on his face, "Get up, someone is seeking revenge!"
Yang Yun looked confused, "What?"
"I have no time to explain. After I leave, you will return to Yang's house and wait. If I don't return in a few days, run away! Run as far as you want!"
Lin Xun couldn't care about anything else, so he took the talisman and ran away.
He looked at the faint marks on his arm with a solemn expression.
If it were an ordinary casual cultivator, he might not even be able to detect it, but he was different. He was extremely sensitive to spiritual energy, and his upper body could feel the mark!
The traces of black energy on it are clearly the devil's tracking method.
Although Lin Xun was puzzled, he acted quickly.
Only by escaping can everyone have a chance of survival.
But why is there magic?
You know, the entire Yue Kingdom is the territory of righteousness.
Demonic disciples are very rare.
Where did the magic come from?
What's the grudge?
He actually wants to plant a mark to track him, is he going to fight to the death?
As for a fight?
Lin Xun never thought that it would be best to escape.
He used the Quick Step Technique and ran wildly outward.
But just for a moment, Chen Xie's joking voice came from behind, "Old man, you are quite clever, but you will definitely die today!"
Before he finished speaking, demonic energy rolled in Chen Xie's hand, and a half-foot-long bloody blade emerged and was thrown towards Lin Xun.
not good!
Lin Xun's heart was beating wildly, he felt like a thorn in his back, and he hit two talismans with his backhand!
In an instant, two spiritual energy shields appeared.
Shield charm!
The bloody blade is coming in an instant!
Bo——
The first layer of shield shattered with the sound, and the second layer of shield shook, but was not damaged yet.
"Talk?" Chen Xie grinned, "It's a way to save his life. Hehe, how many talismans can an old man at the first level of Qi Refining afford?"
